collection_methods: unauthenticated configured public Telegram preview pages

limitations: No Telegram global search or private groups
No X, Facebook, YouTube or general news-site collection
Posts are unverified leads; publication date is not necessarily incident date
RSS availability and update frequency vary by publisher; errors are shown per source.
Only public feed headlines and excerpts are collected; full article content is not mirrored.
Articles are unverified source leads; publication time is not incident time.

summary.notice: Public Telegram preview posts and public RSS/Atom headlines/excerpts only. All items are unverified source leads; publication time is not incident time. Repeated coverage is not independent corroboration. This feed excludes analyst notes and incident decisions.
summary.archive_notice: Daily rolling archive merged from scheduled public-source collection runs. Coverage is bounded by public preview/RSS access and collector limits; this is not a complete record of all posts or news.

The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) is negotiating with Russia and Ukraine about a cessation of hostilities around the Zaporozhye Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP) following a yet another power outage, IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi said. "Once again we are faced with a loss of offsite power at the ZNPP. Its continued reliance on a single power line, together with the plant’s location on the front line of an active warzone, results in an extremely precarious offsite power connection," he said. "I call on both sides to work constructively with the IAEA to cease military activity against electrical infrastructure, facilitate repair of the Ferosplavna-1 line and re-establish an offsite power connection to the ZNPP."

Overnight, Russia carried out a large-scale attack on Zaporizhzhia City using Geran-2 drones and Geran-4 jet-drones. The targets of the attack included an industrial enterprise, an electrical substation, bridges across the Dnieper River, as well as the city's hydroelectric power plant. A large fire broke out at the industrial enterprise following the attack. While the condition of the bridges and hydroelectric power plant is currently unknown, traffic across them in both directions was briefly suspended before being restored two different times, indicating only limited damage.
